thread.topic: Mason second application for knife server

posts.subject: Mason second application for knife server
posts.bodyHtml:
Hello! this is my second knife application and the improved version of it, I decided to change a lot of stuff in the last month, first of all and the most important one was that I improved my behaviour, I improved my activity in Dream TeamSpeak, I have some friends that can prove that I IMPROVED as well.


1) What is your name? Real & Ingame
My real name is Mason and my in game name is ☜☠Mason☠☞ as well.


2) Do I meet the requirements?
Yes I do believe that I meet the requirements after the improvements that I had. I know the knife server for a long time and I'm familiar with the rules and players.


3) How old are you?
I am currently 17 years old


4) Why do you want to join our administrative team?
As I said last time one of the biggest reason that I want to be a admin is helping the community, I am very active on Dream knife server and in fact I'm playing in Dream knife server almost everyday, I'm kinda Addicted to the server, and I don't think we have enough ACTIVE admins for knife sever right now, and we will never have enough admins for the knife server because I believe knife server is one of the servers thet we always need one admin on it to control the server and players, and this is kinda impossible to always have one admin on the server with the numbers of admins that we have right now.


5) How long have you been playing on our servers?
I have been playing on the dream knife server for 255 hours (15262 stamm points)


6) What are your favourite hobbies or pastimes?
My hobbies are gaming and playing knife server I also go in a gym a lot and sometimes I go out with my friends, I'm also a professional ping pong player 😛 , these are my favorite hobbies.


7) Do you think of yourself as mature?
That is a hard question for me right now! I know that I changed my behavior and improved a lot, and many other people can see it as well, but does that mean I'm mature now ?. I'm trying to not swear on the dream knife server anymore and be nice as posible to all the players and I think people can clearly see that, I don't argue with people for small reasons anymore and if they are right and I'm wrong I will just simply say that I was wrong and apologise! I'm trying to be a bit more serious about everything, I'm trying to get people trust back! (I'm tryin to be MATURE) I will never ban/kick/slay anyone before warning them couple of times, I will never abuse my admin powers in any situation, I will try my best to stay calm if somebody trying to trigger me, I will not get offended in the server and rage on people, but however if I get triggered or offended in the worst situation I gonna simply calm myself down and act mature in every situation, do I find myself mature after improvements that I had? YES. (I WILL NEVER ADMIN ABUSE)


8. Have you gained experience as an administrator before?
Not really but as I said the last time I have been watching other admins and how they react to stuff and how they sort the problems out I know how to act when someone is in a bad mood or a good mood.


9) When do you play? (timetable of your average week)
I play in Dream server almost every day, Monday-Thursday 15:00-00:00, Friday 16:00-02:00, Saturday 21:00-03:00, Sunday 12:00-21:00


10) User 1 calls user 2 a "cunt" and proceeds to insult him further - what actions would you take?
If they are friends and just messing around as a joke I don't mind but excessive swearing will be warned, If they aren't friends I would ask him/her nicely to don't insult other players, If player 1 continues after, I will try to calm him/her down but if he/she still continue I will mute him/her, if he/she continues in chat I would kick him/her, If he/she rejoin and keep insulting he will receive a "cooldown/ban" for 30 minutes. If he/she come back after the 30 min ban, and start to insult other players i will not give the player 1 any more warning because he/she already know the rules and did it before, he/she will receive a longer ban, if he/she do this multiple time a higher rank admins will be involved.


11) Strengths
-I am serious when I am in a serious situation and I need to act mature my mother language is not deutsch but I'm leaving in Deutschland for almost 8/9 years so I can speak German.
-I have been playing in a Dream server for a long amount of time.
-Easy to talk to.
-I have respect for everyone in Dream server it's not matter if your 10 years old or 30 years old.
-I have a lot of free time to play on the dream knife server.
-I am trying to be nice mature and friendly with everyone in the Dream knife server (improving myself)
-I am a LOT more active on TeamSpeak in fact I'm in teamspeak almost everyday.


12) Weaknesses
-My English Spelling and grammar is not good but it's understandable ,That's why I decided to write my Applications in English so I can fight with my weaknesses
-I used to have a bad behaviour in past but I'm improving it everyday.


13) Conclusion / Closing remark
I put a lot of work on myself in the last month and improve my behaviour to get the people trust back, I hope that people can see it and give me a chance to prove myself, I have been a lot more active on TeamSpeak and I always try to check the form to be active on form somehow, I still believe that I can be a good admin and help the community to become a better place for everyone.Thanks to all the people that push me into this and helped me write (my improved) application [;)]


A big thanks to @OxygeN that helped me have less spelling and grammar mistakes.

Hello There @BadMasonBadboi


I have some Pros/ Neutral and Negative points without taking too much time and explaining it here let's get into my post.


Pros:
- Your behavior has improved a lot since the last application.
- You have became more active on forum and teamspeak which is great.
- Your activity hours are great.
- You're 17 years of age which is enough withing the application requirements.
- You promised us not to admin abuse.
- Your hobbies are good, I like them 🙂
- Your punishments are good enough.
- You have became a lot more easy to talk to.


Neutral:
- You can not always control players like you said, but it's nice to see that you could try to help them to calm down but nice to see this.
- Will you not admin abuse this is a BIG QUESTION.


Cons:
- Try to practice your English spelling and grammar whenever you have spare time on hand and doing absolute nothing and getting bored.



I have seen a positive turnout from you in case of your behavior so for me it will be a YES, but don't disappoint me when you get your chance 🙂



Good luck in your application and possibly proceeding further with it.



Kind Regards

Michal "OxygeN" J.
